product_one_liner.value: On3 Works uses AI sourcing, screening and ranking, with optional senior-engineer vetting, to help companies hire engineers, developers and IT specialists in the UK and Spain.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists London as headquarters; the official About page instead describes its remote-first headquarters as Mallorca, Spain, without specifying a headquarters city. Sources conflict.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains hiring research, recruitment guides and comparisons, not two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation or help-center link appears in the site navigation or footer; the homepage provides an FAQ instead.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No internal careers page or job board was found; the candidate service recruits for clients rather than listing On3 Works vacancies.

model_provider.notes: The candidate service is powered by Hiron.AI. Its ON3 WORKS LTD privacy notice names Gemini for resume extraction, OpenAI as an extraction fallback, and Cohere for matching embeddings.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy notice claims UK GDPR legal bases and international-transfer safeguards. This is a regulatory-compliance statement, not an independently audited certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile labels the company unfunded; a founder statement describes it as bootstrapped with no external funding. No round date or amount applies.

raised_18mo.notes: The company is listed as unfunded; no outside round is recorded for 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No internal careers page or job board was found; no qualifying live sales vacancy could be verified.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated launch announcement found is the Hostelería Mallorca division on 2026-04-13, before the 2026-05-09 cutoff. Later readable company posts concern research and commentary; updated product guides do not establish a launch date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership listing names the two original founders, John Kinloch (CEO) and Daniel Kinloch; neither is presented as a new appointment, and no qualifying departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No qualifying internal job posts, public documentation or integrations page was found that establishes a CRM or sales/marketing stack.
